fact: Lands Minister Elijah Muchima said the Ministry moved to the new Zambia Integrated Land Administration System (ZILAS) on 17 May 2023 and that over 300,000 title deeds had been processed on it, with over one million accounts recorded.
Law Association of Zambia president Lungisani Zulu describes ZILAS as the Ministry of Lands system in which land documents are submitted, tracked and processed online, producing digital title deeds.

Zambian Business Times reports, citing an official report, that the legacy ZILMIS land system was migrated to the Zambia Integrated Land Management System (ZILAS), with 982 records missing, and that users face intermittent outages.
